info.title: Entra Sign-In Reports BFF - current account
info.description: IF-4, provided by ST-1 (CMP-2). The signed-in account and its roles, used by every screen for the REPORTS and SETTINGS navigation groups (UQ-4) and by the idle-expiry warning. The server still decides access on every route (AD-7).

get.summary: The signed-in account, roles and session limits

account.description: UPN of the signed-in account, shown on the top bar and the denied frame.

authTime.description: When the user last authenticated at Microsoft (UTC).

idleExpiresAt.description: 15-minute idle limit; the SPA warns at least 2 minutes before.

403.description: Signed in but in neither the reader nor the administrator group (type /problems/no-access). An access-denied audit event is written, and no report data is returned. The denied account reaches SCR-1 only through the title, which names the signed-in account's UPN (see NoAccessProblem); no field is added to problem+json.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-sr_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict session cookie issued by the BFF (AD-5).

title.pattern: ^You don't have access\. Signed in as \S+@\S+\.$
title.description: Always 'You don't have access. Signed in as <UPN>.', where <UPN> is the signed-in account's UPN from the validated Keycloak token in the session. SCR-1's denied frame shows the fixed heading 'You don't have access', renders this title verbatim as the line naming the account, and uses it as the assertive alert text (ST-1 AC-5).
examples: You don't have access. Signed in as m.duarte@contoso.com.
